core_obligations: Display the four-term identification G-bullet tensor^L Lf^*F = G-bullet tensor f^*F: by the variant pullback lemma, by flatness of G^n over f^{-1}O_S, and by definition of pullbacks.
Chain the isomorphisms H^i(X, E tensor (G-bullet tensor f^*F)) = H^i(S, Rf_*(E tensor G-bullet) tensor F) through the pullback identification, Leray, and the base-change lemma.

Compatibility with boundary maps: for a short exact sequence of quasi-coherent F's, display the two distinguished triangles (tensoring the base-change triangle and the short-exact-sequence triangle, exact because G^n is flat over S) and the induced commutative square.
Verify the commutativity of the displayed square; the source omits this check - carry it as an explicit obligation.
proof_roadmap: Pullback-flatness identification; isomorphism chain; boundary-map triangles; commutativity obligation.
difficulty_reason: A computation chain with a compatibility clause; the chain is fully named and the commutativity check is carried as an obligation.
